name: Duck Confit
siboNotes: Pure duck confit is naturally FODMAP-free and suitable for SIBO diets. Watch for added seasonings or marinades that may contain garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for garlic or onion powder in commercial versions
Traditional confit uses only duck, salt, and duck fat which are all low FODMAP
Homemade versions allow complete control over FODMAP-friendly seasonings
Crisp the skin under broiler for added texture without FODMAPs
nutritionalHighlights: High in protein for muscle maintenance
